verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments SaaS platform. Whether its source (or its SDKs and plugins) is readable under an open license is a fair openness question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence mentions SDKs, plugins and APIs but never mentions a public source repository or an open-source license, so nothing supports the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
